description: Quote a send (private, to lincoln3:), swap (inside the pool), withdraw (chain: robinhood, base, arbitrum, ethereum, optimism, bsc, solana, zcash, bitcoin, tron; a 0x address, or a Solana/Zcash/Bitcoin/Tron address with a Robinhood Chain refund address) or deposit (public, from the agent wallet). Returns a quoteId, fees, what is received and whether the policy allows it. Show this to the user before spending.

amount.description: Decimal amount of the asset being spent, e.g. "25" or "0.1"

asset.description: Asset spent: ETH, USDG, NVDA… (for swap, the asset you pay with)

chain.description: withdraw only: destination chain, default robinhood

receive.description: withdraw to another chain only: token that arrives, e.g. WBTC, cbBTC, USDC; default is the chain's ETH (or native coin) for ETH and its dollar for USDG

refund.description: withdraw only: Robinhood Chain 0x address a failed bridge or swap refunds to; required for solana, zcash, bitcoin and tron

to.description: send: lincoln3: address · withdraw: recipient address on the destination chain · swap: asset to receive

name: lincoln_quote
title: Quote a spend
